{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
premise_1 = df['customer_segment'].isin(['loyal']).any()
premise_2 = df['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all()
premise_3 = df['customer_segment'].unique().tolist() == ['new', 'returning', 'loyal']

# Report premises
print(f'Premise 1 (loyal exists): {premise_1}')
print(f'Premise 2 (converted is 0/1): {premise_2}')
print(f'Premise 3 (valid segments): {premise_3}')

# Inspect the data
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of -1 in customer_age: {df[df["customer_age"] == -1].shape[0]}')

# Check for QA orders in revenue
qa_filter = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {df[qa_filter].shape[0]}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_count}')"}
